method: same prompt with and without the skill in the arena; both outputs scored by scripts/style_check.py, plus a rubric read
arena: empty temp project root per run, cwd outside any repo, --setting-sources project, CLAUDECODE and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stripped; probes confirmed no user CLAUDE.md and no user skills reach the arena

arms.with_skill: a byte-identical copy of the frozen skill is placed at ./google-style/ in the arena and the prompt is prefixed with an instruction to read and follow ./google-style/SKILL.md, loading the references it routes to
arms.without_skill: the bare prompt in an empty arena

prompts: Write a README for a CLI tool that converts a CSV file to JSON, covering install, usage, and two flags.
Write the setup section of a contributor guide for a Python project that uses uv.
Write release notes for version 2.1 of a logging library that added structured output and deprecated one flag.
Document a REST endpoint that returns paginated results, including error responses.
Write a troubleshooting page for a build tool that fails when the lockfile is stale.
